name: Fireball
description: Hurl a sphere of condensed fire at a single enemy, dealing magic damage.
flavor_text: The first spell. Never grows old.

name: Mana Shield
description: Convert incoming damage to mana loss instead of HP loss for 2 turns.
flavor_text: Why bleed when you can think?

name: Ice Lance
description: Pierce an enemy with a shard of absolute cold, dealing damage and slowing them.
flavor_text: Colder than the void between worlds.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: Call down a bolt of lightning that can chain to nearby enemies.
flavor_text: The sky answers to no one. Neither do you.

name: Arcane Surge
description: Draw on raw arcane energy for a massive damage burst. Drains significant mana.
flavor_text: The line between power and destruction is very thin.

name: Time Slow
description: Distort time around an enemy, giving you two actions before they can move.
flavor_text: Time is just another element to be mastered.

name: Perfect Slash
description: A melee strike infused with arcane force, dealing hybrid physical and magic damage scaling with Strength and Intelligence.
flavor_text: Steel and sorcery. Neither alone is sufficient.

name: Void Infusion
description: Passively infuses all your attacks with void energy, adding bonus dark damage scaling with Intelligence.
flavor_text: You stopped fighting with weapons a long time ago.

name: Shadow Bolt
description: Launch a bolt of concentrated darkness at an enemy, dealing dark damage and applying a chance to fear.
flavor_text: Fear is not a side effect. It is the point.

name: Phantom Step
description: Blink forward through shadow, teleporting a short distance and granting a brief evasion buff on arrival.
flavor_text: Here, then not, then somewhere else. The gap between is yours.
